Photorealistic style. 8K resolution with hyper-detailed metallic surfaces and ray-traced reflections. Single continuous take using slow dolly track push in with cinematic lighting. A sleek futuristic armored vehicle parked in a neon-lit garage, its angular design highlighted by glowing contours. Engine humming with soft vibration, wheels slightly rotating, headlights flickering with dynamic energy pulsation. Shadows shifting across the floor as ambient lights bounce off its polished exterior, holographic control panels subtly activating in the cockpit. Tension building in the air, slow-motion transition as the vehicle begins to rev up into real-time acceleration.

超写实风格。8K分辨率，金属表面极度细腻，光线追踪反射效果。采用慢速轨道推镜连续拍摄，配以电影级灯光。一辆流线型未来主义装甲车停放在霓虹灯光照射的车库中，其棱角分明的设计被发光轮廓线凸显。引擎发出低沉嗡鸣伴随轻微震动，轮胎缓慢转动，前大灯随能量脉动明暗闪烁。环境光线在其抛光车身上跳跃，地面阴影随之变幻，驾驶舱内全息控制面板悄然激活。空气中紧张感逐渐凝聚，随着车辆开始轰油进入实时加速状态，画面转为慢动作过渡。
